## Where

- **Version:** (Store → Account & app → Version, e.g. `Revenue 3.0.0 (3)`)
- **Platform:** Android / Web / Windows, and the version
- **Your role in the store:** Owner / Manager / Assistant
- **Online or offline at the time:**

> Role and connection matter more than they look. A large share of "it did
> nothing when I tapped it" turns out to be a manager-only action, or a write
> that was queued while the connection was down.
